info.title: Gen2X API Reference
info.description:
Use this guide to enable, configure, and manage Impinj Gen2X features on Zebra fixed RFID readers using both MQTT and REST APIs. These features are supported on **FXR60** and **FXR90**. Live-tested on FXR60 reader application **5.0.7** (2026-09-06). All 12 spec example bodies returned HTTP 200.

## Overview

This reference explains how to use Gen2X operations across MQTT and REST for:

- **Protected Mode** (`tagProtect`): Lock individual tags with a password so they are invisible to unauthorized readers.
- **FastID**: Intended to return the EPC and TID in a single inventory response.
- **TagFocus**: Reduce repeated reports from already-read tags so the reader prioritizes new tags.
- **Tag Quieting**: Quiet tags by EPC list (`basic`) or by Gen2 SELECT masks (`advanced`).

Impinj Gen2X extends Gen2 radio and logical layers. Tags must support Gen2X to use these features. For tag compatibility, refer to [Impinj Gen2X specifications](http://www.impinj.com/Gen2X).

The real API is one command: REST `PUT /cloud/impinjGen2X` / MQTT `set_impinjGen2X`. The paths in this guide (`/enable_fastid`, `/quiet_tags`, and so on) are teaching names only. All of them send the same endpoint with a different payload.

## Protocols

This documentation covers both interfaces for the same Gen2X feature set:

- MQTT: Command-based operations for cloud-connected workflows.
- REST: HTTPS endpoints for direct API integration.

Use either interface based on your deployment and integration architecture.

## Before You Begin

- Set up your MQTT connection, broker, and topic before using this API. For setup instructions, see the [Zebra IoTC MQTT Setup Guide](https://zebradevs.github.io/rfid-ziotc-docs/other_cloud_support/MQTT/index.html).
- For REST API integration and setup instructions, see the following guide: [Zebra IoTC HTTP POST Integration Guide](https://zebradevs.github.io/rfid-ziotc-docs/other_cloud_support/HTTP_POST/index.html)
- **Prerequisite:** The target tag must have a valid 32-bit Access Password configured before using Protected Mode operations. The password parameter used in the TagProtect APIs is the same Access Password stored on the tag. These APIs do not create or assign a new password. Write that password first with `PUT /cloud/mode` WRITE to the RESERVED bank, words 2–3. Then send the same 8-character hex value in `tagProtect.password`.

## Getting Started with REST API

### Authentication

1. Send `PUT /cloud/localRestLogin`.
2. Extract the access token from the login response.
3. Add the token to all protected requests.

### Configuration Workflow

Use this sequence to safely stage and apply Gen2X updates:

1. Send `GET /cloud/impinjGen2X` to check the last saved Gen2X configuration.
2. Send `PUT /cloud/stop` to stop inventory if it is running.
3. Send `PUT /cloud/impinjGen2X` with **exactly one** feature object (`fastID`, `tagProtect`, `tagFocus`, or `tagQuieting`). Combining two or more is rejected (HTTP 422).
4. Send `GET /cloud/impinjGen2X` to verify the saved configuration (one feature only). GET echoes what you saved, including `tagQuieting.advanced.preSelect`.
5. Send `PUT /cloud/start` with `applyImpinjGen2X: true` to apply that saved config on **this** inventory session.

After `PUT /cloud/stop`, status returns to `feature: none`. A later start without the flag does **not** re-apply Gen2X. Send `applyImpinjGen2X: true` on every start that should use Gen2X.

## Getting Started with MQTT

Use this sequence for the same workflow through MQTT commands:

1. Send `get_impinjGen2X` to check the last saved Gen2X configuration.
2. Send `stop` to stop inventory if it is running.
3. Send `set_impinjGen2X` with **exactly one** feature object.
4. Send `get_impinjGen2X` to verify the saved configuration.
5. Send `start` with `applyImpinjGen2X: true` to apply it on this session.

## Feature Scope and Behavior

Gen2X supports four features. **Only one may be configured per request.** The reader stores only that last feature.

- **Protected Mode** (`tagProtect`) — targets a tag by EPC for protect/unprotect; visibility actions are reader-wide and must omit `tagID`.
- **TagFocus** — reader-wide `enabled` flag. Targets session S1.
- **FastID** — reader-wide `enabled` flag.
- **Tag Quieting** — `basic` (EPC list) or `advanced` (SELECT masks). Send exactly one of those two objects.

### Mutual exclusion (live)

All four features are exclusive. These combinations return HTTP 422:

- `fastID` + `tagFocus`
- `fastID` + `tagQuieting`
- `tagFocus` + `tagQuieting`
- `fastID` + `tagProtect`
- all three reader-scoped features together

The reader message is: only one Impinj Gen2X feature can be configured at a time (`fastID`, `tagProtect`, `tagFocus`, or `tagQuieting`). TagProtect cannot be mixed with the others.

### Tag Quieting — basic vs advanced

`tagQuieting` must contain **exactly one** of `basic` or `advanced`.

**Basic** (proven on FXR60 5.0.7):

- `action`: `quiet` or `unquiet`
- `tagIDs`: 1–31 hex EPCs
- `quiet` hides a listed EPC for that applied session
- `unquiet` is accepted (HTTP 200) but does **not** restore visibility after stop/start. Start without `applyImpinjGen2X` to see the tag again

**Advanced** (fields introduced in spec 11; PUT accepted HTTP 200 and GET echoes the body; radio effect unproven on local tags):

| Field | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `preSelect[]` | no | Up to 31 SELECT steps first. Each item: `target`, `action`, `mask` |
| `preSelect[].target` | yes (per item) | `S0`, `S1`, `S2`, `S3`, `SL` |
| `preSelect[].action` | yes (per item) | Same enum as `stateAwareAction` (see below) |
| `preSelect[].mask` | yes (per item) | `bank` (`EPC`/`TID`/`USER`/`RESERVED`), `pointer` (0–65535), `length` (1–255), `value` (hex) |
| `tagQuietMasks` | yes | 1–3 values. Allowed: `S0A`, `S0B`, `S2A`, `S2B`, `S3A`, `S3B`, `SL_ASSERT`, `SL_DEASSERT`. No pair like `S0A`+`S0B`. No `S1A`/`S1B` |
| `target` | yes | `SL`, `S0`, `S1`, `S2`, `S3` |
| `stateAwareAction` | yes | Same enum as `preSelect[].action` |

`preSelect[].action` and `stateAwareAction` enum (spec 11):

- SL pairs: `ASSERTSL_DEASSERTSL`, `ASSERTSL_NOTHING`, `NOTHING_DEASSERTSL`, `NEGATESL_NOTHING`, `DEASSERTSL_ASSERTSL`, `DEASSERTSL_NOTHING`, `NOTHING_ASSERTSL`, `NOTHING_NEGATESL`
- Session pairs: `INVA_INVB`, `INVA_NOTHING`, `NOTHING_INVB`, `FLIPAB_NOTHING`, `INVB_INVA`, `INVB_NOTHING`, `NOTHING_INVA`, `NOTHING_FLIPAB`

Do not use the old names (`ASSERTSL`, `NEGSL`, `INV_A`, `FLIPAB` alone). Spec 11 GET examples that still show `stateAwareAction: ASSERTSL` are stale. Live GET stores the PUT value (`ASSERTSL_DEASSERTSL`) and includes `preSelect`.

### Live notes (FXR60 5.0.7)

- **Quiet (basic)** works. A listed EPC disappears for that applied session (proven over repeated trials).
- **Unquiet (basic)** is accepted (HTTP 200) but does **not** restore visibility. The tag becomes visible again after you clear Gen2X (for example `fastID.enabled: false`) and start **without** `applyImpinjGen2X`.
- **Advanced quiet/unquiet** is accepted and stored. Radio effect was not proven on local tags (masks did not match those EPCs).
- **FastID** is accepted and stored. On 5.0.7, tag data events did not include a `tid` field (with or without `tagMetaData: TID`). TID is still readable via a normal mode `accesses` READ of the TID bank.
- **TagFocus** is accepted. Effect is hard to measure because the reader already reports each tag once per session.
- **`enableShortRange`**: if omitted, GET later shows `false`. The reader injects that default.
- **`GET /cloud/status` `impinjGen2X.isActive`**: means a Gen2X config is running this session, not that FastID/TagFocus is switched on. Use GET `/cloud/impinjGen2X` to read `enabled`.

### Feature Persistence

The reader keeps the last saved Gen2X **config** across reboot and MQTT reconnect. Apply is **per inventory session**: you must send `applyImpinjGen2X: true` on each start that should use it.

tags.name: Protected Mode
tags.description: **Prerequisite:** The target tag must have a valid 32-bit Access Password configured before using Protected Mode operations. The password parameter used in the TagProtect APIs is the same Access Password stored on the tag. These APIs do not create or assign a new password. Write it first with PUT /cloud/mode WRITE to RESERVED words 2–3. Protect/unprotect require tagID. Visibility actions must omit tagID. tagProtect cannot be combined with fastID, tagFocus, or tagQuieting. If enableShortRange is omitted, the reader stores false.

tags.name: FastID
tags.description: FastID is intended to return EPC and TID together. On FXR60 5.0.7 the PUT is accepted and stored, but tag data events did not include a tid field. Use GET /cloud/impinjGen2X to see enabled. FastID cannot be combined with any other Gen2X feature in the same request.

tags.name: TagFocus
tags.description: Impinj TagFocus instructs already-inventoried tags (session S1) to remain unresponsive so the reader can focus on new tags. The PUT is accepted. Effect is hard to measure because the reader already reports each tag once per session. Cannot be combined with any other Gen2X feature.

tags.name: Tag Quieting
tags.description: Tag Quieting is basic (EPC list, quiet proven) or advanced (spec 11: preSelect, tagQuietMasks, target, stateAwareAction, including NEGATESL and FLIPAB pairs). Send exactly one of basic or advanced. Cannot be combined with FastID, TagFocus, or TagProtect. Basic unquiet does not restore visibility after stop/start.

tags.name: Gen2X Configuration Retrieval
tags.description: GET /cloud/impinjGen2X (get_impinjGen2X) returns the last saved feature only — not all four, and not whether status isActive means the feature is switched on. Use this GET to read enabled.

tags.name: Control Commands
tags.description: Start and stop inventory. applyImpinjGen2X: true applies the last saved Gen2X config on this start only. Send the flag again after every stop.

post.description:
**Description:** Saves TagQuieting. Use `basic` to quiet listed EPCs, or `advanced` for spec 11 SELECT-mask quieting. Live-proven on FXR60 5.0.7 for **basic quiet** only. **Usage:** Basic: send 1–31 EPCs with `action: quiet`, then start with `applyImpinjGen2X: true`. A listed EPC disappears for that session. Advanced: send `tagQuieting.advanced` with `tagQuietMasks`, `target`, `stateAwareAction`, and optional `preSelect`. The reader stores the body (GET echoes it). Radio effect unproven on local tags. Do not combine with FastID, TagFocus, or TagProtect (HTTP 422). **Parameters — basic:** - **action** (string): Must be `quiet`. - **tagIDs** (array): List of tag EPCs (hex strings), max 31. **Advanced mode** (`tagQuieting.advanced` — select the **Advanced** request example): - **preSelect** (array, optional, max 31): SELECT steps first. Each item needs `target`, `action`, `mask`. - **preSelect[].target**: `S0`, `S1`, `S2`, `S3`, or `SL`. - **preSelect[].action**: SL pairs use ASSERTSL / DEASSERTSL / NEGATESL (e.g. `ASSERTSL_NOTHING`, `NEGATESL_NOTHING`). Session pairs use INVA / INVB / FLIPAB (e.g. `INVB_INVA`, `FLIPAB_NOTHING`). - **preSelect[].mask**: `bank` (`EPC`/`TID`/`USER`/`RESERVED`), `pointer`, `length`, `value` (hex). - **tagQuietMasks** (required, 1–3): `S0A`, `S0B`, `S2A`, `S2B`, `S3A`, `S3B`, `SL_ASSERT`, `SL_DEASSERT`. No `S1A`/`S1B`. Do not send both A and B for the same session. - **target** (required): `SL`, `S0`, `S1`, `S2`, or `S3`. - **stateAwareAction** (required): same enum as `preSelect[].action` (e.g. `ASSERTSL_DEASSERTSL`, `FLIPAB_NOTHING`). Not the old `ASSERTSL` / `NEGSL` / `INV_A` names. `basic` and `advanced` are mutually exclusive. Do not combine TagQuieting with FastID, TagFocus, or TagProtect in the same request. PUT is accepted (HTTP 200) and GET echoes `preSelect`. Radio effect of advanced was not proven on local tags.

command_id.description: Unique identifier to correlate request with response

tagIDs.description: List of tag EPCs (hex strings) to quiet

advanced.description: Advanced TagQuieting configuration using Impinj Gen2X proprietary features.

preSelect.description: Optional array of SELECT operations to position tags into specific session states before applying the state-aware SELECT. Maximum 31 items allowed.

action.description: Action to perform on the target. For target SL, provide an SL action using ASSERTSL, DEASSERTSL, or NEGATESL. For targets S0, S1, S2, or S3, provide a session action using INVA, INVB, or FLIPAB.

value.description: Hex string value to match (even length, valid hex characters).

tagQuietMasks.description: Session-state combinations to check in TID memory. Minimum 1, maximum 3 items. No duplicate session prefixes allowed (e.g., S0A and S0B together).

target.description: Which flag to manipulate based on state check.

stateAwareAction.description: Action to perform when tags match the tagQuietMasks pattern. For target SL, provide an SL action using ASSERTSL, DEASSERTSL, or NEGATESL. For targets S0, S1, S2, or S3, provide a session action using INVA, INVB, or FLIPAB.

post.description:
**Description:** Saves TagQuieting with `action: unquiet` (basic) or an advanced unquiet body. The request is accepted (HTTP 200). **Usage:** Live test on FXR60 5.0.7: after a proven basic `quiet`, applying basic `unquiet` did **not** restore the tag (0/5 trials vs 5/5 when Gen2X is not applied). Quieting is session-scoped. The tag becomes visible again if you save a non-quieting config (for example `fastID.enabled: false`) and start **without** `applyImpinjGen2X`. Advanced unquiet uses the same spec 11 fields as advanced quiet (`preSelect`, `tagQuietMasks`, `target`, `stateAwareAction`). Accepted and stored; radio restore was not proven. **Parameters — basic:** - **action** (string): Must be `unquiet`. - **tagIDs** (array): List of tag EPCs (hex strings). **Advanced mode** (`tagQuieting.advanced` — select the **Advanced** request example): - **preSelect** (array, optional, max 31): SELECT steps first. Each item needs `target`, `action`, `mask`. - **preSelect[].target**: `S0`, `S1`, `S2`, `S3`, or `SL`. - **preSelect[].action**: SL pairs use ASSERTSL / DEASSERTSL / NEGATESL (e.g. `ASSERTSL_NOTHING`, `NEGATESL_NOTHING`). Session pairs use INVA / INVB / FLIPAB (e.g. `INVB_INVA`, `FLIPAB_NOTHING`). - **preSelect[].mask**: `bank` (`EPC`/`TID`/`USER`/`RESERVED`), `pointer`, `length`, `value` (hex). - **tagQuietMasks** (required, 1–3): `S0A`, `S0B`, `S2A`, `S2B`, `S3A`, `S3B`, `SL_ASSERT`, `SL_DEASSERT`. No `S1A`/`S1B`. Do not send both A and B for the same session. - **target** (required): `SL`, `S0`, `S1`, `S2`, or `S3`. - **stateAwareAction** (required): same enum as `preSelect[].action` (e.g. `ASSERTSL_DEASSERTSL`, `FLIPAB_NOTHING`). Not the old `ASSERTSL` / `NEGSL` / `INV_A` names. `basic` and `advanced` are mutually exclusive. Do not combine TagQuieting with FastID, TagFocus, or TagProtect in the same request. PUT is accepted (HTTP 200) and GET echoes `preSelect`. Radio effect of advanced was not proven on local tags.

**Description:** Retrieves the last saved Gen2X configuration. The reader stores only one feature object at a time. **Usage:** Send this command with an empty payload. The response contains only the latest configured feature. Use this GET to read `enabled` on FastID or TagFocus. `GET /cloud/status` `impinjGen2X.isActive` only means Gen2X is running this session. If no Gen2X configuration has been set, the response is an empty object. **Parameters (MQTT & REST):** _No parameters required._

**Description:** Starts inventory and, when `applyImpinjGen2X` is true, applies the **one** Gen2X feature last saved with `PUT /cloud/impinjGen2X` / `set_impinjGen2X`. **Usage:** Save exactly one Gen2X feature first. Cannot be combined with a BLE-only start (`scanType: ["ble"]`). **Parameters (MQTT & REST):** - **applyImpinjGen2X** (boolean): `true` to apply the saved Gen2X config on this inventory session.
